description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_Injector_RemoveSpansWithoutAttributes' that extends 'HTMLPurifier_Injector'. It implements logic to remove 'span' elements without attributes from HTML content, including methods for preparing the injector and handling elements and their end tags.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Injector_RemoveSpansWithoutAttributes
classes.description: A class that removes span tags without attributes during HTML purification.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object, particularly setting up the storage for tokens marked for deletion.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares the injector with configuration and context objects, and initializes attribute validator.

methods.name: handleElement
methods.description: Processes a token representing an HTML element; if it's a 'span' with no attributes, marks it and its closing tag for removal.

methods.name: handleEnd
methods.description: Handles the end token, removing it if it was marked for deletion.
